latestArticle.title: We Gather Together: A Hymn of ThanksgivingIf there is a “Thanksgiving Hymn,” then “We Gather Together” is likely it. At the time it was written in 1597, the Netherlands was fighting a war of liberation against the Spanish King Philip II. This was the same Philip who sent the Armada to conquer England, and the British were able to defeat them thanks to a violent storm and the courage of the British Navy. While under the dominion of the Catholic king, the Protestants in the Netherlands were forbidden to worship as they wanted. The song praises God as an ally and expresses their gratitude toward Him in their struggle for freedom. In 1626, the song appeared in a hymnal of Dutch folk and patriotic songs.According to Wikipedia, Adriaen Valerius wrote the song, but another source listed the author as anonymous. The author of the poem that became known as “We Gather Together” is anonymous, while Adriaen Valerius wrote the actual song. The song entered the US in 1903.I first learned this song back in the 5th grade when we were singing in the classroom. We only learned the first verse, and I was happy to learn more about the song and more verses in the present time. latestArticle.title: ❤️ At first, people thought it was just an ordinary video… but when they saw this daughter-in-law carrying her elderly father-in-law on her shoulders, their eyes filled with tears. What was it that made her take such a remarkable step?During the Chhath festival in Bihar, a video emerged that beautifully captured the true meaning of family relationships. An elderly father-in-law wished to visit the Chhath Ghat, seek the blessings of Chhathi Maiya, and offer his prayers during this sacred festival. However, due to his old age and physical weakness, he was unable to walk.Perhaps the family thought that this time Baba would not be able to visit the ghat and that his wish would remain unfulfilled. But one daughter-in-law made a decision that moved not only the people present there but also thousands of people who watched the video on social media.She lifted her helpless, elderly father-in-law onto her shoulders.And then the journey began… Step by step, she kept walking towards the Chhath Ghat with her father-in-law on her shoulders. How long the journey was, how heavy the burden felt, or how tired she became… perhaps none of that mattered to her. There was only one thought in her heart: Baba wants to visit the Chhath Ghat, so I must take him there.At an age when elderly people need someone to support them, this daughter-in-law became that support. A relationship that society sometimes considers an outsider’s relationship was filled with so much love and affection by her that people were left wondering: What could be a more beautiful example of humanity and family bonds?In today’s world, where relationships are breaking apart over property, where elderly people sometimes suffer from loneliness in their own homes, and where parents long for just a few moments of companionship from their children… this daughter-in-law carrying her father-in-law to the ghat is nothing short of an inspiration.This video is not just about going viral… it is a mirror for those who view relationships only through the lens of responsibility, obligation, or selfish interests.Whether it is a daughter, daughter-in-law, son, or any other family member… the true value of a relationship is revealed when we make the wishes of our loved ones our own happiness.🙏 A daughter-in-law like this is truly special… She did not see her father-in-law merely as an elderly member of the family, but as someone deserving of love, care, and respect.A home blessed with such a daughter-in-law will never let its elderly members feel alone. Truly, through her actions, she has shown that humanity is still alive… and some relationships are not built by blood, but by the heart.Watching this video will make you pause for a moment… because what this daughter-in-law did is something that cannot be fully expressed in words; it can only be felt with the heart. ❤️#Humanity #Family #ViralVideo #News1India #ChhathPuja
